title: v1.0.97 — Streamlined AI Recommendations Exclusive to Analytics
description: AcademicPulse v1.0.97 streamlines the interface by keeping the AI Study Recommendation engine exclusively in the Analytics view, decluttering the main Dashboard overview while providing rich standard-wise diagnostic insights in Analytics.
features:
🎯 Analytics-Exclusive AI Recommendation Engine
AI recommendations now live exclusively in the Analytics view, analyzing all 27 accounting standards and providing diagnostic prescriptions, accuracy pills, and instant action shortcuts.

✨ Clean Dashboard Overview
Removed recommendation widget from the main Dashboard page to preserve focus on core streaks, study time, and today's schedule.

🚀 Independent Analytics Execution
AI recommendation cards now render instantly within Analytics without waiting for Chart.js canvas elements to load.

🔄 Cache & PWA Synchronization
Updated service worker cache and asset query strings (style.css?v=23, app.js?v=118) to ensure smooth update rollouts.
